package fixture

func Generic[T any](value T) (result T, err error) {
	return body(value)
}

func (service *Service) Method(value int) (string, error) {
	return body(value)
}

var callback = func(value int) string {
	return body(value)
}

type Handler func(value int) (string, error)

type Interface interface {
	Method(value int) (string, error)
}
